discoveryCoverage: Three candidates identified in a coordinator reading of Conrad-named macOS Yarn nodes, then bound to both builds. This is not exhaustive special-scene discovery, independent review or evidence of runtime reachability. Non-Conrad nodes, other resource families and dynamic consumers remain pending; texture text is excluded by owner decision.

cases.observedSourceBehavior: Conrad contrasts not being physically dirty with being sexually dirty, using the same word and emphatic formatting. The player has two initial replies; one leads to a conditional continuation based on an earlier activity and a further reply.
cases.invariant: Preserve the contrast and suggestive meaning, the deliberate shrinking drawn-out opening, exact markup and the distinct branch identities; do not make the previous-activity condition part of translated text.
cases.adaptationRoute: Review both meanings and all replies together using an approved Russian glossary; choose actual target wording and feasible tag placement before ordinary translation.
cases.nonTextDependencies: The source uses size and italic markup, face commands and the $conrad_jerked_off_3 state. Runtime rendering, visibility and all state combinations remain unverified.
acceptanceScenarios: Exercise both first replies and both values of the recorded previous-activity condition.
Reject wording that collapses both meanings or removes the intended progressive visual effect.

cases.observedSourceBehavior: After the player calls their work professional in one reply, Conrad says he is too and clarifies that his expertise is receiving hand jobs. Another reply leads to a different response. A state-dependent continuation follows.
cases.invariant: Preserve the echoed claim and delayed sexual punchline, the distinct reply and state/branch identities, and the owner's neutral player wording strategy.
cases.adaptationRoute: Translate and review the complete setup and response as one group after the glossary gate; do not assume gendered language for the player.
cases.nonTextDependencies: The state variable $conrad_jerked_off_3 is read and written in the source; other state checks, scene presentation and runtime conditions require review.
acceptanceScenarios: Exercise the professional reply and alternative reply without merging their continuations.
Reject wording that makes Conrad's echoed claim or delayed clarification incoherent.

cases.observedSourceBehavior: Conrad invents the nickname big C. One player reply repeats it questioningly and Conrad abandons it; the alternate reply addresses him by name.
cases.invariant: Keep the nickname tied to Conrad's name, preserve the questionable self-invented nickname and both branches, and maintain the source emphasis markup.
cases.adaptationRoute: After the approved Russian name/glossary is ready, choose and review one nickname and its repeated form together; preserve the joke rather than mechanically retaining an unexplained Latin initial.
cases.nonTextDependencies: Source face commands, italic markup and route context are bound to this node; actual rendering and route reachability remain unverified.
acceptanceScenarios: Exercise both responses and verify the appropriate continuation and convergence.
Reject a nickname whose repeated form or connection to the approved character name is lost.
